result:
My verdict on DG5 round 3 is **PASS**, on candidate `sha256:fc93b239…` (2187 files, source `bbd6294`). I raised one new finding, F-DG5-102, which is Low and doesn't block the gate. Nothing Critical, High or mandatory is open.

I checked the candidate ID first, in the repository and in a full disposable clone. It matched, and `bbd6294..HEAD` changes only `docs/delivery/`.

**New finding**
- **F-DG5-102 (Low, not a mandatory violation, REQ-S16-001, owner backend-workflow-engineer).** The module-boundary unit test at `apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts:200` has a fixed 30 s limit, and it ran out of time under review load.
  - It failed 2 of my 3 full Node 22 unit runs (41.7 s and 36.9 s, at load 15–23), so `pnpm test` exited 1 both times.
  - It passes when run alone (17.4 s), and the third full run passed (20.3 s at load ~10). Unloaded it takes about 9 s.
  - It is a spurious failure that forces a manual re-run. It never hides a boundary violation.

**The repairs**
- **BE-X1 (G4 evaluator):** the change only adds missing items. My own probe checked this:
  - an empty approved portfolio leaves all 8 G4 criteria incomplete;
  - facts that weren't loaded still fail closed;
  - a complete portfolio still passes, and removing any single fact makes its criterion incomplete.

  So no path lets a gate decide with less evidence.
- **BE-X2 (demo seed):** I ran a second probe on the real demo dataset. Every new seeded row passes:
  - each writer holds the permission the matching API action requires;
  - no Finance validation is by its author, and funding is decided by FIN in the role the API would record;
  - each write has exactly one audit event;
  - the demo access admin has no approval permission;
  - seeding is still refused in production, including after a real bootstrap.
- **FE-X1 (table regions):** markup only. No handler, session-bound action or route changed. The `p5-forms` and table-region e2e specs passed 8/8 on a production stack and 10/10 on a demo stack (with the demo walkthrough and labels specs), in English and Arabic.
- **D-173 observations (h)–(k) and the test-9 time limit:** all accepted with reasons. I added one similar cosmetic item to (i): the seed records Finance's baseline validation as `business_case.validate_baseline` instead of `business_case.baseline_validate`. It already existed before this round.

**Checks run**
- Build, typecheck, lint, `openapi:lint` (846 operations), `check:no-cdn` and `format:check` all exit 0.
- Node 24 unit tests: 2340 / 1711 / 259 passed, plus 2 known skips.
- Node 22 unit tests: see F-DG5-102 (third full run and isolated re-run pass).
- Integration with the locale unset: 318/318 files, 3056 passed + 1 known skip.
- Integration with `LANG=C.UTF-8`: every test passed, but the run exited 1 because the `afterAll` cleanup hook in `packages/db/test/integration/demo.test.ts` timed out. That file passes 9/9 when re-run alone. It happened once, so I disclosed it rather than raising it.
- My round-1 and round-2 reproductions, re-run unchanged, pass 10/10. Auditors get no success response on any of the 90 P5 write operations, and an admin-only user sees no transformation data.
- The historical validators for DG4 to DG1, the DG5 register check and `--pipeline` all pass.

Every non-zero exit is disclosed and explained in the record. That includes my own probe's first attempt, which failed because of a bug in the probe, not the product. I removed the clone and all scratch files at the end.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- reviews/DG5/round-3/code-security-reviewer.json
- reviews/DG5/round-3/code-security-reviewer.findings.json
- test-evidence/DG5/code-security/round-3/
